Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer with expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and AI-driven solutions. The ideal candidate will work on integrating large language models (LLMs), data platforms, and cloud-based architectures to enable advanced analytics and intelligent applications.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable data pipelines using Azure data services.
Work with structured and unstructured data to support AI/ML and GenAI use cases.
Integrate Generative AI models (LLMs) into data platforms and applications.
Build and manage data solutions using Azure tools like Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks.
Develop and optimize data workflows for performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
Collaborate with data scientists and AI teams to deploy and operationalize models.
Implement data governance, security, and compliance best practices.
Work on prompt engineering, vector databases, and embeddings for GenAI solutions.
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and AI systems.
